source: AS/NZS 1170.0:2002 4.2.2 ultimate combinations (1.35G; 1.2G + 1.5Q; 1.2G + ψc Q + Wu; 0.9G + Wu; G + ψE Q + Eu) and 4.3 serviceability (G + ψs Q, G + ψl Q), the factors ψ of Table 4.1 for floors of the general occupancies (residential, offices, parking: ψc 0.4, ψE 0.3, ψs 0.7, ψl 0.4) and roofs (ψc 0, ψE 0)

strength.name: 1.35G
strength.source: AS/NZS 1170.0 4.2.2(a): 1.35G (permanent action only; F and H with G)

strength.name: 1.2G + 1.5Q
strength.source: AS/NZS 1170.0 4.2.2(b): 1.2G + 1.5Q (earth pressure with the imposed factor 1.5: AS/NZS 1170.0 4.2.3, SAEngine practice)

strength.name: 1.2G + ψc Q + Wu
strength.source: AS/NZS 1170.0 4.2.2(d): 1.2G + ψc Q + Wu, ψc 0.4 (Table 4.1, floors), 0 for roofs

strength.name: G + ψE Q + Eu
strength.source: AS/NZS 1170.0 4.2.2(f): G + ψE Q + Eu, ψE 0.3 (Table 4.1, floors), 0 for roofs

service.name: G + ψs Q + Ws
service.source: AS/NZS 1170.0 4.3 with the serviceability wind Ws of the 1/25 annual probability: SAEngine takes Ws = (V25 / V500)² Wu = (37 / 45)² = 0.68 Wu (region A, SAEngine practice; enter the region's ratio for B, C, D)

allowable.name: G
allowable.source: Permissible stress design (masonry and timber of the parent pack): characteristic actions

allowable.name: G + Ws
allowable.source: Characteristic permanent actions with the serviceability wind (0.68 Wu, see service)

allowable.name: G + ψs Q + Ws
allowable.source: Characteristic actions with ψs Q and the serviceability wind

overstrength: AS/NZS 1170.0 and AS 1170.4 give no system overstrength factor Ω0: the earthquake combination is G + ψE Q + Eu; Ω0 = 1.0 in the systems (SAEngine practice), so the overstrength cases equal the ordinary ones

sources.seismicDeadUpper: AS/NZS 1170.0 4.2.2(f): G (factor 1.0); AS 1170.4 has no general vertical earthquake component on G (seismic.verticalFactor 0)
sources.storageFactors: Table 4.1 storage: ψc 0.6, ψE 0.6, ψs 1.0, ψl 0.6: not applied (the combinations use the general floor factors; override them for storage)
